auditor_eli: Hi all — quick SOC2 fieldwork ask. We need RBAC change events (service accounts + console edits) for Nov 2024
through May 2025, KMS rotation proofs for any customer CMKs, and one IR playback showing user deprovision (redacted). Prefer raw ndjson + a signed manifest. Which artifacts map to CC6/CC8?

kate_sec: hey @auditor_eli  we can produce that. We keep CloudTrail for IAM/STS events and an internal audit-index for UI-proxied edits. Well include correlation_id & request_id on each record for traceability.

tom_infra: internal examples: UI edit record -> audit.event=ui.role_change, fields: time,actor,resource,before,after,correlation_id,request_id. CloudTrail shows UpdateRole/PutRolePolicy events.

auditor_eli: good. For KMS, do you include HSM attestation refs if the key is HSM-backed, and do rotation proofs include a signed hash?

kate_sec: yes. kms.rotation records include rotation_id,key_arn,rotation_time,sha256_proof and hsm_attestation_ref when available. We also export CloudTrail CreateKeyRotation and ScheduleKeyDeletion if present.

export-bot: Export job started (id exp-20250520-03) by tom_infra. Objects: rbac.ndjson, internal_audit.ndjson, kms_rotations.ndjson, ir_playback.md, manifest.sha256, manifest.sig. Uploading to s3://redwood-audit-exports/exp-20250520-03/. Presigned links will be valid 7 days.

auditor_eli: please include a short control mapping file linking artifacts to SOC2 CC6, CC8 and ISO A.9/A.10. Also need verification steps for manifest.sig.

kate_sec: adding control_mapping.txt. Verification instructions included: 1) sha256sum each file -> match manifest.sha256 lines, 2) verify manifest.sig using ed25519/verifier, example: `ed25519_verify -pub pubkey.pem -sig manifest.sig -data manifest.sha256`.

tom_infra: note: internal audit-index hot retention 180 days; older events archived and need ~48h restore. CloudTrail retention 365 days. If you later request >6 months for internal logs, ping here early.

auditor_eli: thanks all. We'll validate the bundle and ping back if chain-of-custody or missing correlation ids show up. :thumbsup:
